plain: A request for money, votes, or business

webster.text: Earnest request; a seeking to obtain something from another with some degree of zeal and earnestness; sometimes perhaps, importunity.

example.quote: KING remarked that we were refining too much in this business; and that the idea of preventing intrigue and solicitation of offices was chimerical.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, June 23, 1787
